fit: oral sunflower oil and positive suggestion, composite well-being
assessment: The waiting-list control had no placebo. The oil-plus-suggestion package favored a composite including relaxation (interaction p<.001). No isolated relaxation or anxiety estimate, neutral-instruction oil arm, cold-pressed grade or Parkinson population.

fit: acute tart cherry concentrate and mental-fatigue VAS outside Parkinson disease
assessment: In 27 healthy adults in an acute crossover, the fatigue treatment p=.690 and treatment-by-repetition p=.288. The matched cordial comparison is an independent inconclusive contrast in acute task fatigue, using concentrate.

fit: concentrate and exercise endurance or neuromuscular performance
assessment: The registered experiment uses performance and muscle outcomes under an exercise-fatigue title. It has no reported clinical fatigue scale, individual results, whole dried fruit or Parkinson cohort.

fit: 2 g per day corn comparator and sertraline in coronary disease
assessment: Final article adjusted BDI-II corn minus omega difference −1.26 (95% CI −4.48 to 1.97, p=.44). Published and author-manuscript unadjusted means differ. No oil-free arm or stated refining grade.

fit: corn oil comparator in a 21-day small trial outside Parkinson disease
assessment: Author abstract reports no clear corn-arm Beck change and 20% versus 67% no longer meeting the study depression threshold. Group denominators, estimated effect, corn grade and oil-free comparison are unavailable.

fit: corn capsules as an adolescent depression comparator
assessment: Published CDRS-R contrast 1.81 (95% CI −3.31 to 6.94, p=.49). Linked registry reports 16 in an imaging scope and paper 51 randomized, with unresolved relationship. No oil-free control, grade or Parkinson cohort.

fit: corn-oil comparator and Hamilton depression in heart failure
assessment: Posted intention-to-treat Hamilton means 14.9 with corn, 15.1 with EPA/DHA and 15.7 with EPA (p=.74 and .45 versus corn). These are formulation contrasts in a non-Parkinson setting without an oil-free control or stated corn grade.

fit: corn oil as adjunct comparator in major depression in Lahore
assessment: The article calls a within-arm change with p=.007 insignificant. It lacks a directly reported between-arm estimate and flow explaining the 70 stated and 61 tabulated participants. No oil-free or refining contrast.

fit: 2 g per day corn versus EPA on common sertraline
assessment: Adjusted Beck endpoints were 10.3 with corn and 12.1 with EPA (difference 1.74, 95% CI −1.04 to 4.52, p=.22). No oil-free arm, confirmed refining grade or Parkinson population.

fit: corn comparator and registered PHQ-9 in distressed adults
assessment: Registration names corn oil and planned depression assessment. It has no posted results. The linked journal report was retracted. No result used.

fit: fresh mango versus cookies and planned depression questionnaire
assessment: The open-label crossover registers depression scores at baseline and four weeks. The instrument and results are unavailable. The healthy adult exposure is fresh mango.

fit: dried mango offered among optional snacks and aggregate affect
assessment: The randomized exposure was video content. The article aggregates intake across six snacks and measures momentary affect. It gives no individual mango exposure, separately attributable effect or depressive symptom severity.
